messages:
Liam O'Connor: hey team, day 1 kube weirdness. followed the onboarding doc, but when I switch contexts I sometimes get "Forbidden" and other times it works. using macOS. any quick checks? /cc @DevEx

DevEx: welcome Liam! can you paste `kubectl config current-context` when it fails and the exact error? also did you merge multiple kubeconfigs from personal laptop?

Liam O'Connor: Current context when failing: `redwood-prod` (I may have an old personal cluster context too). Error: 
Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "user:liam@redwood.com" cannot list resource "pods" in the namespace "staging"
I noticed I have two idp entries in `~/.kube/config` (idp:liam and idp:liam.legacy).

DevEx: classic merged-config problem. run `kubectl config view --minify --flatten` to see which user the context maps to. If it's pointing at the legacy idp entry you can `kubectl config unset users."idp:liam.legacy"` or create a fresh kubeconfig via the quickstart script.

Liam O'Connor: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n staging` -> "no" when failing. I checked Okta and I'm not in `redwood:platform` or `redwood:team-staging` groups.

InfraOps: if Okta group missing, canonical fix is People Ops -> add to `redwood:team-staging`. For short-term unblock infra can apply a RoleBinding in `staging` to your user. Example we apply: 
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: onboarding-liam-temp
  namespace: staging
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "user:liam@redwood.com"
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: staging-developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

Which do you prefer? temp binding or wait for People Ops?

Liam O'Connor: temp binding please, I need to run the local e2e that hits staging. Also will clean up my kubeconfig.

Onboard Bot: access request 9951 created. Infra will auto-apply a temp binding if requested.

InfraOps: applied onboarding-liam-temp in staging (auto-revoke in 8h). Try again.

Liam O'Connor: confirmed: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n staging` -> "yes" and `kubectl get pods -n staging` returns pods. thanks!

People Ops: following up to add Liam to `redwood:team-staging` in Okta so infra can remove the temp binding. Expect sync within 24h.

DevEx: thanks Liam. Doc updates: add a short troubleshooting section covering merged kubeconfigs, `kubectl config unset users."<old-user>"`, and the Okta group mapping. Also add a note about avoiding personal cluster contexts on the same config file. We'll open a PR with snippets. :thumbsup:
